name: Zero-Touch
blurb:
✅ The Precision Pinch: Forget shaky volume sliders. By calculating the Euclidean distance between the thumb and index finger, I’ve created a "virtual dial" in the air. 

✅ Intent Recognition: Using a 1.5s temporal hold for the "Fist" gesture, the system now distinguishes between you moving your hand and you actually wanting to Pause/Play. 

✅ Return-Swipe Shield: Solved the biggest headache in gesture CV—the "accidental back-swipe." The system now ignores movement for 0.8s after a track skip, making the experience rock-solid.
